title: Change detection
content: @ng-select/ng-select and @ng-select/ng-option-highlight fully support zoneless change detection — the default for new Angular apps since v21. No setup is required: the libraries do not depend on zone.js (it is not in their dependency graphs) and work identically whether your app is zoneless or still uses zone.js. Both modes are covered by the unit-test suite in CI, and this docs site runs zoneless.

title: Custom styles
content: If you are not happy with the default styles you can easily override them with increased selector specificity or by creating your own theme. This applies if you are using no ViewEncapsulation or adding styles to a global stylesheet.

title: Custom styles

title: Custom styles
content: Keep in mind that ::ng-deep is deprecated and there is no alternative to it yet. See angular/angular#17867.
